short_description: NorthPeak Retail — a live inventory view for store operations that surfaces shortfalls and prescribes the recovery move (transfer, expedite, or substitute) for a manager to approve, turning governed lakehouse data into action today. Targets ~$10M/yr revenue recaptured from fewer stockouts and ~$12M/yr margin protected from earlier markdowns, with capped auditable AI spend (~$200K/yr bounded, per-store attributable via Unity AI Gateway) and real-time store action replacing batch-reporting latency. Built for Priya Raghavan (SVP Retail Ops), Amara Nwachukwu (VP Finance), Tobias Lindqvist (Dir Data Engineering), and Hector Villalobos (Platform Engineering Lead).
